sloka: ताः प्रहृष्टाः प्रकृतयो बल अध्यक्षा बलस्य च ।श्रुत्वा यात्राम् समाज्ञप्ताम् राघवस्य निवर्तने ॥२-८२-२४॥
transliteration: tāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ prakṛtayo bala adhyakṣā balasya ca ।śrutvā yātrām samājñaptām rāghavasya nivartane ॥2-82-24॥

translations.english: Having come to know that orders were issued to send the army on an expedition to bring back Rama, the subjects and the army chiefs were delighted.
